# GSAP

Locally bundled GSAP core version 3.15.0. No runtime CDN request or paid plugins.

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.15.0/dist/gsap.min.js

The original copyright and license notice is retained at the top of gsap.min.js.
License: https://gsap.com/standard-license/
Documentation: https://gsap.com/docs/v3/GSAP/gsap.matchMedia()/

The application animation module uses matchMedia to clean up effects when reduced
motion preferences change. CSS never conceals content pending GSAP initialization.
